summary: Elaborated every planned story for iteration `customer-feedback-form` with requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, assumptions, cross-story rules, and evidence. Preserved planned story ids: `feedback-public-link-resolution`, `feedback-link-expiry-rule`, `feedback-form-display`, `feedback-server-validation`, `feedback-record-update`, `feedback-repeat-submission-display`, and `feedback-form-non-browser-verification`. Captured the clarified product rules: feedback links are valid for 30 days, and repeat visits after submission show existing feedback read-only. No tests, browser checks, Playwright, app server, deployment, publishing, or real email delivery were run for this business-analysis task.
